attrs.discharge: NOT discharged. TAX-27A-OBSERVER is the open record. A two-run checker over a model of the runner already exhibits a timing channel that a file-observer misses.
attrs.note: This record is why the file exists. The prose form of this assumption on TAX-RELATIONAL-2 cites `NEW-27A-OBSERVER`, an id no record has ever carried.
attrs.statement: Cell 27a's non-interference statement is made against a MODEL of the runner; the real runner's observer model, including timing and resource-usage channels, is undeclared.
